response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_all FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_all) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_all;

assumptions.assumption: Each matched player_award row counts as one award winner; repeat winners count once per award row.

alternatives.interpretation: Count each player who won at least one award only once.
alternatives.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS tally FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_all FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_all) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_all;
